rules: We run 6-man: the buyer never counts in the comp.

steps.text: On start, ALL the DPS go forward. Only the Heal Scrapper stays back and activates it.
Kill Enervator 1 — right at the starting point.
GO BACK along the path and kill Enervator 2 (the one furthest back).
Walk to Enervator 3, which sits where number 4 spawns.
As number 3 is starting: the Chrono generates clones and places a PORTAL WITH CS as far forward as possible, then comes back.
Kill Enervator 4 (it spawns there when Desmina gets close).
TAKE THE PORTAL.
Kill Enervator 5, up on the left, on the little slope.
Go back to Enervator 6, slightly behind.
Kill Enervator 7, on the middle rise.
Head straight to the next one. A portal here is OPTIONAL.
Kill Enervator 8, the highest one, on the right.
Come back down and kill ONLY ONE of the two that spawn together (just to buy time). Rule: for a doubled pair it is not worth killing both.
Go up: one on the left, one on the right. Kill the LEFT one first.
While the left one is being killed, the Chrono places a PORTAL WITH MIMIC (no CS, it won't be up) right at the right-hand one.
Kill the right one, place a portal, kill the LAST Enervator and head up.
